name: Hana Bhattacharya
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Hana Bhattacharya are lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 28, the augmentation scarring around their temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) — and they make no effort to hide it.

They inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. They work as a sniper out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Hana Bhattacharya describe them as a precision instrument — point them at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Kamala Fedorov-Ampofo on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Kamala Fedorov-Ampofo intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A Tier 4 executive offers Kamala Fedorov-Ampofo a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Kamala Fedorov-Ampofo represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended

physical_description.heritage: South Asian foundation (78.3%) with significant Middle Eastern (13.4%), Indigenous American (6.2%), and minor Sub-Saharan African (2.1%) ancestry — a diaspora blend reflecting the genetic complexity of the 2226 Ubiquitous Diaspora. Strong South Asian facial structure with Middle Eastern warmth, subtle Indigenous American cheekbone prominence, and gentle depth from African ancestry creating complex, layered physiognomy.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with defined musculature — the physique of someone who trains obsessively. Minimal body fat, long limbs built for stillness and precision rather than raw power.
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to scalp on sides, slightly longer on top — practical, minimal maintenance, exposes augmentation scarring deliberately
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep warm complexion with rich amber and golden undertones grounded in South Asian base, warmed by Middle Eastern influence, subtly deepened by Indigenous American and African ancestry. Evenly textured, luminous rather than matte.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, prominent cheekbones blending South Asian angularity with Indigenous American prominence, defined angular jaw characteristic of South Asian and Middle Eastern heritage, expressive mouth. Skin taut over bone. Minimal grooming beyond function — no cosmetics, no softening aesthetics. The face of someone who has optimized for efficiency.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged silvered scar tissue spanning temples to jawline on both sides of skull — residual scarring from cortical bomb installation and subsequent removal by street doc, uneven and rough
Fine white line running down center of sternum — surgical access point for synthetic blood integration
Faded burn scar on inner left forearm — old, pre-augmentation, origin unknown
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Surgical-grade chrome visible at temples and along jawline where scarring pulls skin tight — no cosmetic casing, raw interface points visible. The augmentation itself is internal, but the trauma of installation and removal is permanently written on their face.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with minimal wasted movement — shoulders slightly forward, weight balanced. Moves with deliberate precision, economical gestures. When still, they achieve an unsettling stillness — the kind trained shooters develop. Eyes constantly tracking distance and angles.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear — fitted tactical pants with reinforced thigh panels and cargo pockets, layered synthetic long-sleeve tops in muted grays and blacks, a weathered synthetic leather overjacket without branding. No corpo logos. Boots are serious — heavy-duty treads, reinforced ankle support. Everything is maintenance-ready and durable over fashionable. Worn but meticulously clean.

Raw chrome augmentation interfaces visible at temples and jawline, jagged silvered scar tissue crossing both sides of skull from cortical implant removal. Minimal expression, taut skin over bone structure, unsettling stillness. Wearing muted gray layered synthetic tactical wear, weathered synthetic leather jacket, heavy-duty reinforced boots. Standing in neon-lit GLMZ alleyway, rain-slicked concrete, distant holographic ads casting blue and pink light across scarred face. Posture economical and controlled, shoulders slightly forward, the bearing of a trained operative at rest.
